notes: Maintenance release: CR audit RF-2 (#989), the continuous-effect fixes from re-audit RA-2. Rules behavior changes: encounter-length effects (icebreaker pumps, Datasucker/Leech/Wyrm weakening) end when the run ends during the encounter (CR 6.1.4, 10.3.1b); Thunderbolt Armaments' and Null: Whistleblower's strength changes last for the run, and Bad Times' memory cut ends with the turn in progress (CR 1.2.1, 9.10.1). A facedown installed Runner card has no active abilities, through one shared active-card check (src/state/active.ts; CR 1.8.3a, 8.1.4a): no statics, pumps or breaks. One CR 9.12.1d-e dependency sort orders blanking and the ice subtype layer (orderByDependency); lingering blanks survive a blanked source, the morph subtype swap and 'cannot be lowered' respect blanking, negative host modifiers count as lowering, and Hush's 'cannot gain abilities' is read. Şifr on Wraparound gives 7 (CR 9.12.1a). Effects on a card end when it changes zones (CR 1.12.1-2), and Trieste Model Bioroids applies only while active (CR 9.4.1). Chum's net damage fires when the encounter ends unbroken (CR 9.6.13c, 6.8.5.ex1). Pins cards v1.147.25.
